slides.headline: There's a reason you keep //[[gold]]re-explaining yourself[[/gold]] to AI
Most of them start from nothing every time
slides.body: Close the app and the conversation is gone. Your name, the allergy, the fact you don't eat meat on weekdays — all of it, every time.

slides.headline: You end up narrating your own life, daily
slides.body: And because it's tedious, you stop bothering — so you get generic answers, which is what made it feel useless in the first place.

slides.headline: What it looks like when it sticks

turns.text: [next week, in a shop] What about this one?
That's got shrimp paste in it — skip it.

items.text: Your name, and the people you mention
items.note: so it knows who "my daughter" is

items.text: A shopping list that's still there tomorrow
How you like it to talk to you
items.note: blunt, warm, chatty, brief — you pick

slides.headline: You can make it [[gold]]forget[[/gold]], too
slides.body: Tell it to drop something and it's gone. Delete the lot from inside the app whenever you want. Memory you can't undo isn't a feature, it's a problem.

slides.headline: Tell it once. That's the whole pitch.
slides.body: Free on iPhone. No account to make.
